name: Trojan
tagline: Scans a vibe-coded repository for critical vulnerabilities and opens fix pull requests.
problem: Fast AI-assisted development often skips security review.
solution: An agent scans the codebase, flags vulnerabilities with explanations, and generates fix PRs.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a repo, open a vulnerability and merge the fix.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[1Password] Best Security Hack” among 169 submissions.
Grounds the pitch in cited industry statistics.

lessons: Security agents that ship the fix beat ones that file a report.
